data.name: Rehan
data.gender_notes: Rehan is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic rayḥān, 'fragrant herb, basil', from the root ر-ي-ح (r-y-ḥ), 'scent'. Its root is ر-ي-ح-ن (r-y-ḥ-n). A Qur'anic word (Sūrat al-Raḥmān 55:12). Rehan is a Arabic name meaning “Fragrant herb (basil); sweet-smelling”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rehan expresses “Fragrant herb (basil); sweet-smelling”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic rayḥān, 'fragrant herb, basil', from the root ر-ي-ح (r-y-ḥ), 'scent'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rehan total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
